Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-104.json runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1 --slot 23 --why "Slot 23 gives max separation for the leading pair (candidates 1 and 2, highest support product) while preserving later slots for confirmation."

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1 --slot 27 --why "Slot 27 separates both the 0-vs-1 and 1-vs-2 pairs at max sigma while keeping slot 28 available for the top 0-vs-2 pair afterward."

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1 --slot 37 --why "Slot 37 gives max separation for the only remaining contested pair, candidates 0 and 2, now that candidate 1 has collapsed."

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1 --slot 46 --why "Slot 46 is the best remaining separation for the only contested pair, candidates 0 and 2, though the separation has weakened to under 2 sigma."

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1 --why "Candidates 0 and 2 remain close at 0.42 versus 0.54 support with no future slot separating them by more than 2 sigma, so the data cannot resolve the alias to theta and I abstain."

content.text:
Campaign complete for **case-104** (`runs/dev-v1b-case-104-r1`).

- **Start:** 6 candidates, top three at support 0.44 (P=0.945d), 0.33 (P=17.06d), 0.17 (P=1.06d).
- **Obs 1 (slot 23, t=61.49):** tested the leading pair (candidates 1 vs 2) → candidate 2 jumped to 0.52, candidate 1 fell to 0.17.
- **Obs 2 (slot 27, t=67.10):** resolved candidate 1 out entirely (0.010) while probing 0-vs-2; candidate 2 led at 0.59, candidate 0 at 0.33.
- **Obs 3 (slot 37, t=80.14):** best remaining separation for the 0-vs-2 pair, but it only tightened the race (0.44 vs 0.51) — diagnostics showed no future slot separating this pair above ~2σ.
- **Obs 4 (slot 46, t=90.15):** final best-available shot at 0-vs-2; landed at 0.42 vs 0.54, still far below θ=0.997, and diagnostics returned no separable pairs left.

**Verdict:** abstained — 4 of 6 observations used, max support 0.542 (candidate index 2, P≈17.06d), below the 0.997 resolution threshold. The 0.945d/17.06d alias for this star's window genuinely cannot be broken further with the remaining epochs.
